description: A three-channel 32-step sequencer whose notes are written in from a CV input, with a fourth channel for staging a sequence while the other three play. All channels share one length

params.text: Shows the black notes of the display as sharps or as flats
Shows that group of 8 steps out of the 32 in the display and the gate buttons. No effect on channels 1 to 3 while the sequencer is running
When on, the voltage at CV IN is rounded to the nearest semitone as it is written. It acts on what is written, so some channels can hold quantized notes and others not
Cycles the gate of that step of the shown window: a normal gate that follows the clock pulse width, a held gate that stays high for the whole step and ties into the next, or off
Steps on to the next channel for display and editing, through the three playing channels and the staging channel
Copies all 32 steps of the selected channel, pitches and gates, whatever the STEPS knob is set to. Pressing it again cancels a paste that is waiting
Pastes the copied channel into the selected channel, at the moment chosen by the PASTE SYNC switch
Starts and stops the sequencer. While it runs, the three playing channels follow the clock and the staging channel does not
Stores the voltage at CV IN into the current step of the selected channel
Moves the sequencer one step to the left. No effect on channels 1 to 3 while the sequencer is running
Which voltage the selected channel's CV output carries while the sequencer is stopped: in the SEQ position the voltage stored at that step, in the other the voltage at CV IN
Moves the sequencer one step to the right. No effect on channels 1 to 3 while the sequencer is running
The number of steps played before the sequence repeats, 1 to 32, shared by every channel
When on, a write advances the sequencer one step to the right
Whether a paste happens at once, on the next clock, or at the start of the next sequence. A paste into the staging channel always happens at once, whatever this is set to

inputs.text: The voltage written into the current step; anything from -10V to 10V is stored
Sets or clears the gate of the step being written; with nothing patched, the stored gate is left as it was. No effect on channels 1 to 3 while the sequencer is running
A rising edge above 1V stores the voltage at CV IN into the current step
A rising edge above 1V moves the sequencer one step to the left
A rising edge above 1V moves the sequencer one step to the right
Advances the sequencer one step on each rising edge
A rising edge above 1V returns every channel to its first step
A rising edge above 1V starts or stops the sequencer

outputs.text: The voltage stored at the step channel 1 is playing, 1V per octave when notes are stored
The voltage stored at the step channel 2 is playing, 1V per octave when notes are stored
The voltage stored at the step channel 3 is playing, 1V per octave when notes are stored
The gate of the step channel 1 is playing, 10V when high
The gate of the step channel 2 is playing, 10V when high
The gate of the step channel 3 is playing, 10V when high

notes: The display shows the note nearest a stored voltage that was written without quantizing; octaves above 9 carry a top bar and those below 0 an underscore
menu: Arrow controls — sets whether the left and right buttons Step the sequencer or Rotate the contents of the selected channel
Reset on run — returns the play head to the start every time the sequencer is started
Retrigger gates on reset — holds the gate outputs low for 1ms after a reset so a trigger-sensitive target fires again; the choices are No, Yes, and Only when Run cable is unconnected
Portable sequence — holds Copy sequence and Paste sequence, which move the selected channel between this module and other sequencers that support the format
